tasks.title: Add task retrieval functionality
tasks.description: Implement function to retrieve task details from Notion by page ID
detailed_requirements: Create getTask(pageId) function that queries Notion API
Parse and return task properties (title, status, notes, assigned to)
Handle cases where task does not exist
Add error handling for API failures
acceptance_criteria: Returns null or throws meaningful error for non-existent tasks

tasks.title: Add task listing with filters
tasks.description: Implement function to list tasks from Notion database with optional filtering
detailed_requirements: Support filtering by status (To-do, In Progress, Done)
Return array of task objects with key properties
Implement pagination support for large result sets
Add sorting options (by creation date, status, etc.)
acceptance_criteria: Can retrieve all tasks from database
Filters work correctly for status and assignee
Pagination works for databases with >100 tasks

tasks.title: Add input validation layer
tasks.description: Implement validation functions for all input parameters
detailed_requirements: Create validation helpers for task title (non-empty string)
Validate status values against allowed set
Add validation for notes field (string, max length)
Throw descriptive errors for invalid inputs
acceptance_criteria: All functions validate inputs before API calls
Invalid inputs result in clear error messages
Edge cases handled (null, undefined, empty strings)

tasks.title: Enhance error handling with retry logic
tasks.description: Implement comprehensive error handling with retry mechanism for transient failures
detailed_requirements: Add retry logic for network failures (exponential backoff)
Distinguish between retryable and non-retryable errors
Improve error messages with actionable guidance
acceptance_criteria: Rate limit errors respect Retry-After header
All errors logged with sufficient context

tasks.title: Implement task deletion functionality
tasks.description: Add function to archive/delete tasks from Notion

tasks.title: Extract configuration to separate module
tasks.description: Refactor configuration management into dedicated config module
detailed_requirements: Add optional configuration for retry behavior, timeouts
acceptance_criteria: Missing required vars throw startup error

tasks.title: Separate Notion API client into module
tasks.description: Extract Notion API interactions into dedicated client module
detailed_requirements: Move all Notion API calls to client
Implement consistent error handling in client
acceptance_criteria: All Notion SDK calls isolated in notionClient.js

tasks.title: Add bulk task operations
tasks.description: Implement functions for bulk task creation and updates
detailed_requirements: Implement parallel API calls with rate limiting
Return summary of successes and failures
acceptance_criteria: Partial failures don't block entire operation

tasks.title: Create comprehensive test suite
tasks.description: Implement unit and integration tests for all functions
detailed_requirements: Set up testing framework (Jest or Mocha)
Create unit tests for all exported functions
Mock Notion API calls for unit tests
Create integration tests with test database

tasks.title: Add comprehensive documentation
tasks.description: Create detailed README with setup, usage, and API documentation
detailed_requirements: Document all exported functions with examples
Add usage examples for common scenarios
acceptance_criteria: New users can set up project from README alone
All functions documented with code examples

tasks.title: Add JSDoc documentation to all functions
tasks.description: Add comprehensive JSDoc comments to all functions for IDE support
detailed_requirements: Add JSDoc to all exported functions
acceptance_criteria: Parameters and return types clearly documented

tasks.title: Add support for custom task properties
tasks.description: Enable dynamic task properties based on database schema
detailed_requirements: Support custom property fields in createTask
Allow property configuration via config file
Handle different property types (select, multi-select, date, etc.)
acceptance_criteria: Can create tasks with custom properties

tasks.title: Implement CLI interface
tasks.description: Add command-line interface for task operations
detailed_requirements: Support commands: create, update, list, get, delete
Add interactive prompts for missing parameters
Format output for CLI display (tables, colors)
Support JSON output mode for scripting
acceptance_criteria: Can be used in shell scripts

tasks.title: Add webhook/event listener support
tasks.description: Implement webhook server to receive Notion database change notifications
detailed_requirements: Set up Express server for webhook endpoint
Trigger callbacks on task events (created, updated, deleted)
acceptance_criteria: Server can run alongside existing functionality

tasks.title: Add logging framework
tasks.description: Implement structured logging with configurable log levels
detailed_requirements: Support log levels (debug, info, warn, error)
Support JSON log format for parsing
acceptance_criteria: All console statements replaced with logger

implementation_phases.name: Core Feature Completion
implementation_phases.objective: Complete basic CRUD operations with validation

implementation_phases.name: Reliability & Quality
implementation_phases.objective: Enhance reliability, add tests, improve logging

implementation_phases.name: Advanced Features
implementation_phases.objective: Add deletion, bulk ops, custom properties
